name: barbell deadlift from blocks
description: A deadlift with the bar raised on blocks, which shortens the range of motion and lets you lift heavier.
instructions: Set the bar on blocks or a raised platform.
Stand with the bar over your mid-foot.
Hinge and grip the bar just outside your knees.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Drive through your feet to stand tall.
Lower the bar back to the blocks with control.
